title: In vitro FOXP3 knockdown in human PBMCs
description: Human FOXP3 antisense oligonucleotides (ASOs) target effects in primary iTregs gene expression. Tregs were isolated from human PBMCs from 5 different donors, subjected to one of 4 different treatments: (1) Untreated, (2) Control ASO 792169, (3) FOXP3 ASO 910959, (4) FOXP3 ASO 910956 under either stimulation with aCD3/aCD28 coated beads or left unstimulated.
